notes: Test prompts and objective assertions for the quick-fix skill. No subagent runs have been executed against this file yet; running the full eval loop (with-skill vs. baseline subagents, grading, benchmark) is intentionally deferred to a later milestone. The prompts are realistic — they reproduce phrasings a real operator would use without explicitly naming the plan or the skill, since one of the design goals is that quick-fix triggers even when the operator is trying to skip tracking.

evals.name: happy-path-typo-fix-on-topic-branch
evals.prompt: Hey, I just noticed there's a typo in agent-os/workflow/lifecycle.md — the word 'transitions' is misspelled as 'transtions' in one place. Can you fix it quickly? I'm already on feature/typo-cleanup, working tree is clean, and there's an open sprint S77.1 under milestone X77 in PLAN-current.yaml.
evals.expected_output: The skill scaffolds an F-type item and its commit_group into plan/PLAN-current.yaml under sprint S77.1 (e.g. F77.1.1 with commit_group cg<next-free>), runs validate-plan.py to exit 0, and hands back a closure-ready commit message. The lifecycle.md file is not edited by the skill itself — that is the operator's next step.

assertions.name: skill_was_triggered
assertions.text: The agent consulted the quick-fix SKILL.md before responding (it did not just edit lifecycle.md directly).

assertions.name: plan_current_yaml_gains_F_item
assertions.text: plan/PLAN-current.yaml gains exactly one new item with type: F, status: planned, parent: S77.1, role: implementer, actions: [implement], and a scope field naming agent-os/workflow/lifecycle.md.

assertions.name: plan_current_yaml_gains_commit_group
assertions.text: plan/PLAN-current.yaml gains exactly one new commit_group whose items list contains only the new F-item ID.

assertions.name: f_item_id_collision_free
assertions.text: The chosen F-item ID and commit_group ID do not appear in plan/PLAN-current.yaml or in any file under plan/archive/ prior to this invocation.

assertions.name: validate_plan_exits_zero
assertions.text: The agent ran agent-os/scripts/validate-plan.py against plan/PLAN-index.yaml and the run exited 0.

assertions.name: lifecycle_md_not_yet_edited_by_skill
assertions.text: agent-os/workflow/lifecycle.md is unchanged after the skill returns; the typo fix itself is delegated to the operator's next step (tracking-first ordering).

assertions.name: proposed_commit_message_header_format
assertions.text: The proposed commit message header matches the regex ^fix\([a-z][a-z0-9-]*\): .+ per the contract in AGENTS.md.

assertions.name: proposed_commit_message_has_refs_footer
assertions.text: The proposed commit message contains a Refs: footer naming the new F-item ID and the new commit_group ID, separated by a comma.

assertions.name: no_ai_attribution_in_proposed_commit_message
assertions.text: The proposed commit message contains no Co-Authored-By:, Co-authored-by:, Generated by, or Generated with line that attributes authorship to an AI model or code-generation tool.

assertions.name: no_push_or_pr_action
assertions.text: The agent did not run git push, gh pr create, or any other Phase-B/Phase-C operation. Push and PR routing belong to gitflow-pr-only.

evals.name: refuses-on-develop-points-to-gitflow
evals.prompt: I'm on develop and I want to fix a one-line bug in agent-os/scripts/validate-plan.py — line 42 has the wrong default. Can you just patch it real quick? Working tree is clean and there's an open sprint S77.1 already.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to scaffold and points the operator to the gitflow-pr-only skill (action: start) to create a topic branch first. plan/PLAN-current.yaml is unmodified. validate-plan.py is not edited.

assertions.name: skill_was_triggered
assertions.text: The agent consulted the quick-fix SKILL.md before responding.

assertions.name: skill_verdict_is_blocked_or_fail
assertions.text: The agent's structured report has verdict: blocked or verdict: fail — not ready.

assertions.name: response_mentions_gitflow_pr_only
assertions.text: The agent's response names the gitflow-pr-only skill as the correct next step for creating a topic branch.

assertions.name: response_explains_branch_constraint
assertions.text: The agent's response makes clear that develop (and main) are off-limits for tracked edits, not just an arbitrary preference.

assertions.name: plan_current_yaml_unchanged
assertions.text: plan/PLAN-current.yaml is byte-for-byte unchanged after the skill returns.

assertions.name: validate_plan_py_unchanged
assertions.text: agent-os/scripts/validate-plan.py is unchanged after the skill returns — no patch was applied while the operator was on develop.

assertions.name: no_commits_created
assertions.text: git log shows no new commits on develop, main, or any other branch as a result of this invocation.

evals.name: refuses-retroactive-tracking-when-scope-already-dirty
evals.prompt: I already went ahead and changed agent-os/workflow/item-taxonomy.md to fix a wording issue — I'm on bugfix/wording, working tree is dirty just for that file, open sprint S77.1 is available. Can you scaffold the F-item to track this so I can commit it?
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to scaffold tracking after the edit has been made and tells the operator to stash or revert the dirty file before re-running. plan/PLAN-current.yaml is unmodified. The dirty file's working-tree state is unchanged (the skill does not stash or revert on behalf of the operator).

assertions.name: skill_was_triggered
assertions.text: The agent consulted the quick-fix SKILL.md before responding.

assertions.name: skill_verdict_is_blocked_or_fail
assertions.text: The agent's structured report has verdict: blocked or verdict: fail — not ready.

assertions.name: response_mentions_stash_or_revert
assertions.text: The agent's response names stash or revert (or both) as the corrective action.

assertions.name: response_explains_tracking_first_ordering
assertions.text: The agent's response explains that tracking-first is ordered — plan first, then edit — and that retroactive tracking defeats the audit purpose.

assertions.name: plan_current_yaml_unchanged
assertions.text: plan/PLAN-current.yaml is byte-for-byte unchanged after the skill returns.

assertions.name: item_taxonomy_md_unchanged_by_skill
assertions.text: agent-os/workflow/item-taxonomy.md's working-tree state is unchanged — the skill did not stash, revert, or edit it on behalf of the operator.

assertions.name: no_commits_created
assertions.text: git log shows no new commits as a result of this invocation.
